title: Gabor-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Fast Simulations of Acoustic Wavefields
abstract: arXiv:2502.17134v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have gained attention for solving partial differential equations, including the scattered Helmholtz equation, due to their flexibility and mesh-free formulation. However, their performance suffers from low-frequency bias, particularly in high-frequency wavefield simulations, limiting convergence speed and accuracy. To address this, we propose a novel and simplified PINN framework that incorporates explicit, trainable Gabor basis functions to efficiently capture the localized and oscillatory nature of wavefields. Unlike previous Gabor-based PINNs that rely on multiplicative filters or auxiliary networks to learn Gabor parameters, our approach redefines the network's task as learning a nonlinear mapping from input coordinates to a custom Gabor coordinate system, where a Gabor function captures the dominant oscillatory behavior of the wavefield. tldr: 提出一种引入显式可训练Gabor基函数的简化PINN框架，将网络任务重新定义为学习从输入坐标到自定义Gabor坐标系的非线性映射，有效克服了PINNs的低频偏差问题，实现高频声波场的快速高精度模拟。
en_tdlr: A simplified PINN framework with explicit trainable Gabor basis functions is proposed, which redefines the network's task as learning a nonlinear mapping to a custom Gabor coordinate system, overcoming low-frequency bias for fast and accurate high-frequency acoustic wavefield simulations.
